You can find pre-made Product Requirements Document (PRD) templates across top workspace platforms like the [Notion Marketplace](https://www.notion.com/templates/category/product-requirements-doc), [Atlassian Confluence](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements) , and [ChatPRD](https://www.chatprd.ai/templates).[[1]](https://www.notion.com/templates/category/product-requirements-doc)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[3]](https://www.chatprd.ai/templates)

### Standard PRD Structure

A comprehensive PRD typically contains these core sections:[[1]](https://productschool.com/blog/product-strategy/product-template-requirements-document-prd)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)

- **Metadata** : Document title, owner, status, release date, and team contacts.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[2]](https://productschool.com/blog/product-strategy/product-template-requirements-document-prd)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)
- **Overview & Context** : Problem statement, business goals, and strategic value.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[3]](https://monday.com/blog/rnd/prd-template-product-requirement-document/)
- **Target Audience & Personas** : Who the feature is for and user stories/scenarios.[[1]](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/requirements-management/what-is-a-good-product-requirements-document-template)[[2]](https://monday.com/blog/rnd/prd-template-product-requirement-document/)[[3]](https://productschool.com/blog/product-strategy/product-template-requirements-document-prd)
- **Success Metrics** : Quantitative and qualitative indicators of a successful launch.[[1]](https://productschool.com/blog/product-strategy/product-template-requirements-document-prd)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)
- **Functional Requirements** : Core features, user flows, and acceptance criteria.[[1]](https://productschool.com/blog/product-strategy/product-template-requirements-document-prd)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)[[3]](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/requirements-management/what-is-a-good-product-requirements-document-template)
- **Out of Scope (Non-Goals)** : What will *not* be built in this phase to prevent scope creep.[[1]](https://www.prodmgmt.world/blog/prd-template-guide)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[3]](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/requirements-management/what-is-a-good-product-requirements-document-template)
- **Assumptions & Open Questions** : Technical, business, or design risks and unresolved queries.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/product-requirements)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewfneGyjhaY&t=32)[[3]](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/requirements-management/what-is-a-good-product-requirements-document-template)

### Popular Framework Examples

- **Asana / Two-Stage Spec** : Splits the process into a Project Brief (problem-first) followed by a Project Proposal (solution), enforced by an approval checkpoint.[[1]](https://www.prodmgmt.world/blog/prd-template-guide)
- **Lenny's 1-Pager** : A concise, problem-first format popular in fast-moving product teams.[[1]](https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/my-favorite-templates-issue-37)[[2]](https://www.edovanroyen.com/p/the-ultimate-collection-of-prd-templates)
- **Uber PRD** : Includes a detailed PRD checklist alongside an impact matrix for multi-product systems (Rider, Driver, Eats) and legal/privacy fields.[[1]](https://www.prodmgmt.world/blog/prd-template-guide)

If you'd like, let me know:

- What **type of product or feature** you are building
- Which **tool or platform** your team uses (Notion, Confluence, Google Docs, etc.)

I can help you outline the exact sections you need for your draft.
